verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM and agent. Admins can confirm devices are managed, see each device's security posture and enforce settings. Macs enroll through Apple MDM, Linux runs the Oneleet Agent with security checks, and macOS and Windows get a one-click secure baseline. However, the evidence never names the specific checks in the story or shows posture tied to individual employees. Missing for 10: documented disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks; per-employee compliance tracking or reporting; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration

citations.quote: Admins can confirm that devices are managed, see each device’s security posture, enforce security settings, and take remote action when a device is lost, stolen, or being offboarded.
Linux workstations are managed through the Oneleet Agent as well, with security checks and remote actions across major distributions.
Oneleet offers a recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows that can be applied in one click.
Macs enroll through Apple's Mobile Device Management framework, either manually or zero-touch through Automated Device Enrollment
